references.text: Contains the Ten Commandments, which are the foundation of the law Jesus refers to
Encourages loving the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength, which is closely linked to the greatest commandment Jesus mentions
Expresses love and value for God's law, which is relevant to the discussion about the greatest commandment in the law
Jesus quotes from Deuteronomy 6:5 as the greatest commandment and adds another from Leviticus 19:18, which summarizes the Law and the Prophets
A parallel event where Jesus mentions the greatest commandment and the second greatest, similar to his answer in Matthew
